values.note: 30-amp water/electric $35 (back-in or pull-through); 50-amp water/electric $35 back-in, $40 pull-through; full hookup (50-amp) $45 back-in, $50 pull-through. Standard occupancy 2 adults and 4 children; $5 per additional person. Paid in full at booking. Long stays are paid in 28-day increments (28 days paid up front = 4 days free).

fees.source: https://www.waynecountyfairgrounds.net/camping/ ('CAMPSITE RATES': 30 AMP $35/night Back-In/Pull-Through; FULL HOOK-UP Back-In $45/night, Pull-Through $50/night; 50 AMP Back-In $35/night, Pull-Through $40/night; 'Policies last updated September 22, 2026'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.waynecountyfairgrounds.net/camping/ ('Good Sam Club Members, Seniors Receive 10% Off All Posted Rates'), read 2026-10-22. The operator states no military discount; the stored military: true came only from the Good Sam directory and is cleared.

hookups.source: https://www.waynecountyfairgrounds.net/camping/ ('ELECTRIC 30 & 50 Amp available'; 'FULL HOOK UP Over 40 sites with sewer'; 'Water hookup included'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: '100+ Sites'; over 40 with sewer. Tent camping discontinued; one RV per site.

sites.source: https://www.waynecountyfairgrounds.net/camping/ ('100+ Sites · Full Hookups'; 'Pull-through sites available'; 'Tent camping discontinued. One RV per site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online (Firefly) or by phone (734) 697-7002. Stays over 2 weeks are booked by phone; long-term camping has a waitlist. All campers must be RVIA certified; RVs 15+ years old must submit 4 photos when booking. Cancellation: one night forfeited 48+ hours out, no refund inside 48 hours.

booking.source: https://www.waynecountyfairgrounds.net/camping/ (policies 1-11 and FAQ) + https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/WayneCountyFairground ('Any reservation over 2 weeks please call the office to book your long term stay'; Nightly reservation search), read 2026-10-22

note: RV park at the Wayne County Fairgrounds off I-94 near Belleville (10871 Quirk Rd), 10 minutes from DTW airport, run by the nonprofit Wayne County Fair Association rather than county government. Closed during the six-day county fair in August. Long-term campers share the park. --Claude
summary: Operator page (policies updated 2026-09-22): $35 (30-amp back-in) to $50 (full-hookup pull-through), 30/50-amp, 40+ full-hookup sites, pull-throughs, showers, laundry; Good Sam and senior 10% off (good_sam confirmed; directory-only military cleared); nightly online booking on Firefly. Season not stated (derived Apr 15 - Oct 31 left alone). Phone (734) 697-7002 matches. Note cleaned (hookups, facilities, booking in fields).
flags: Fairgrounds check: public nightly camping is sold across the season on Firefly (not fair-week-only), but 'Campground closed during Wayne County Fair dates' (six days in August; 2027 dates not yet posted).

Long-stay check: long-term stays are paid in 28-day blocks and 'Call to inquire or join waitlist'; the old note called it a seasonal RV park, and the operator gives no count of long-term sites. It passes the tests as published: $35 base, nights sold online with no minimum, no application for a nightly stay. The 4-photo rule applies only to RVs 15+ years old (EKKO is a 2023), and all campers must be RVIA certified.
